book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn MADIU

content: Karasaras en Kamadipw Lapalap en Kapwopwoud
Sises pil ketin usehlahte sapwellime karasaras akan ong aramas ako oh pil mahsanih,
“Wehin Koht rasehng nanmwarki men me ketin onopada kamadipw en kapwopwoud en sapwellime pwutak.
E ahpw poaronehla sapwellime papah ko pwe re en kairehki me ale luhk en iang kamadipwo, re en patodohla; irail ahpw sohte men iang towehda.

E pil pwurehng poaronehla ekei sapwellime papah, e ahpw mahsanihong irail, ‘Kumwail kairehki irail kan me iang ale luhk ong ni kamadipw wet, pwe iet I onopadahr ei kamadipw; nei kouwolo oh nei mahn wih kan kamalahr oh mehkoaros soandier; re en patodohla.’
Me ale luhk ko ahpw sohte mwahn nsenohki, pwe emenemente wiewia nsene: emen patohla nansapw, a emen nan eh sidohwa;
a meteiko poarohng papah ko, wokih irail oh kemeirailla.
Nanmwarkio ahpw engiengda kowahlap oh ketin poaronehla sapwellime karis pwe re en kemehla aramas loallap suwed pwukat oh isikada ar kahnimw.
E ahpw malipepene sapwellime papah ko oh mahsanihong irail, ‘Eri, I onopadahr ei kamadipw en kapwopwoudet, a irail ko me I lukehier, sohte warohng iang.
Eri, kumwail kohwei nan ahllap akan oh lukedohng ni kamadipw wet irail kan koaros me kumwail pahn tuhwong.’
Sapwellimen nanmwarki papah ko ahpw kohieila nanial akan oh kapokonepene aramas koaros me re tuhwong, me mwahu oh me suwed kan. Wasahn kamadipwo eri pokonla mehlel.
“Nanmwarkio ahpw ketilongala pwe en mahsanih tohn kamadipwo; e ahpw masanihada ohl emen me sohte mi nan kapwat en kamadipw.
E ahpw keinemwe reh, ‘Nahn ia duwen omw pedolongodo met nan omw sohte mi nan kapwat en kamadipw?’ A ohlo nennenlahte, sohte mwekid.
Nanmwarkio ahpw mahsanihong me papah ko, ‘Kumwail salihpene peh oh neh kan, oh keseieilahng nan rotorot mosul, pwe en sengiseng oh ngih kan tehtehrek wasao.’”
Eri, Sises ahpw ketin kaimwiskala karasaras wet, mahsanih, “Pwe me ngeder me aleier luhk, a me malaulau me pilipildahr.”
Duwen Isais ong Sihsar
Parisi ko ahpw pokonpene pwe re en kapwungada nanpwungarail dahme re pahn kak kasapwungehki Sises ni sapwellime mahsen kan.

Irail eri ilakihalahng rehn Sises ekei neirail tohnpadahk ko oh me kin uhpalihki Erod kei pwe re en idek reh, patohwan, “Maing Sounpadahk, se patohwan ese me komwi aramas mehlel men, me kin padahk ni mehlel duwen kupwur en Koht ong aramas akan; komw sohte kin kupwurohki dahme aramas akan kin lemeleme, pwe komwi sohte kin ketin katohre aramas.
Eri, komwi mahsanihong kiht mahs kupwuromwien, ong ni ire wet: me pwung ong atail kosonned akan, ma kitail pahn kin kihda daksis ong nanmwarkien Rom, de soh?”
Sises ketin tehkada arail lamalam mwersuwed, iei me e mahsanihong irail, “Mwalaun kei kumwail! Dahme kumwail kasongosongehkin ie?
Kumwail kasaledohng ie mwohnien isaiso.” Irail eri patohwanohng elep en toala silper.
Ih eri keinemwe rehrail, mahsanih, “Sansal en ihs oh mwaren ihs met?”
Irail patohwanohng, “Sansal en Sihsar oh mwaren Sihsar.” Sises eri mahsanihong irail, “Me mwahu, eri, kumwail kihong Sihsar mehkan me en Sihsar, a ong Koht mehkan me sapwellimen Koht.”
Ni ar rongada met, re inenen pwuriamweikihla, re ahpw pirekekte patopatohla.
Peidek duwen Iasada Sang Mehla
Rahnohte Sadusi kei pwarodo rehn Sises. (Iei irail soangen aramas ko me kin koasoia dene me melahr akan solahr pahn iasada.)
Irail eri patohwanohng Sises, “Maing Sounpadahk, Moses koasoanedier ma ohl emen me sohte nah seri pahn mehla, rie ohl pahn uhd pwoudikihda liohdio pwe en kapwaiong rie me melahro kadaudoke.
Eri, pwihn pirien ehu kin mihmi reht, ohl isimen. Me laudo eri pwopwoudida, oh mehsang eh pwoudo, sohte neira seri. Eri, nin duwen tiahk wet, rie ohlo ahpw pwoudikihda liohdio.
Soahngohte pil wiawihong me keriemeno oh pil me kesilimeno, kohkohla lel me kaisimeno.
Mwuhr, liho ahpw mehla.
Eri, nin rahn me melahr akan pahn iasada, ihs rehn me isimeno me pahn wia en liho eh pwoud, nan irail koaros ar pwoudikidahr?”
Sises ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “Kumwail inenen sapwung, kisehn amwail sohte wehwehki Pwuhk Sarawi oh manaman en Koht!
Pwe mwurin me melahr akan ar pahn iasada, re pahn duwelahr tohnleng kan en nanleng, ohl oh lih akan solahr pahn pwopwoud.
A met, ong ni irair en iasadahn me melahr akan, kumwail sohte kin wadek dahme Koht mahsanihong kumwail? E mahsanih,
‘Ngehi me Koht en Eipraam, Koht en Aisek, oh Koht en Seikop.’ Eri, met wehwehki me ih Koht en me momour akan, a kaidehkin Koht en me melahr akan.”
Ni pokono ar rongada met, re ahpw pwuriamweikihla sapwellime padahk.
Kosonned me Keieu Lapalap
Ni Parisi ko ar rongada me Sises ketin katokehdi en Sadusi ko ar peidek kan, re ahpw pokonpene;
emen irail, sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo, ahpw men lidipiheki Sises sapwellime mahsen kan, e ahpw patohwanohng,
“Maing Sounpadahk, mehnia kosonned nan pelien Kosonnedo me keieu kesempwal?”
A Sises ketin sapengki, “‘Ke pahn poakohng Kaun-o omw Koht sang nan kapehdomw unsek, sang ni ngenomw unsek, sang ni omw lamalam koaros unsek.’
Ih met kosonned me keieu lapalap oh kesempwal.
A me keriaun kesempwal, me rasehngete met, iei: ‘Ke pahn poakohng mehn mpomw duwen omw kin poakohng pein uhk.’
Kosonned riau pwukat, iei me poahsoanen pelien Kosonned en Moseso oh padahk en soukohp ako.”
Peidek duwen Mesaia
Ni Parisi ko ar pokonpene, Sises ahpw keinemwe rehrail, mahsanih,
“Dahme kumwail lemelemehiong Mesaia? Kisehn mehnia kadaudok ih?” A re patohwanohng, “Ih kisehn kadaudok en Depit.”
A e pil keinemwe rehrail, mahsanih, “A dahme Ngenen Koht audehkihda Depit pwe en kahdaneki ‘Ei Kaun?’ Pwe iet me Depit patohwan:

content.text: I lao pahn wiahkihla omwi imwintihti kan utupen aluweluwomwi kan.’

content: Eri, ma Depit kahdaneki ih ‘Kaun,’ a ia duwen eh kak kisehn kadaudok en Depit?”
Eri, sohte emen me kak sapengki Sises mehkot; oh sang ni rahno kohla sohla me idek reh mehkot.
